Field Station

Your mobile AI observation lab.

Watch the sky, capture video and radio-frequency data, and turn detections into evidence people can review. Field Station brings the camera feed, anomaly models, and research tools into one interface.

Capture locally.

Keep video and correlated RF measurements at the station. Local storage supports observation when the field setup is away from an internet connection.

Review what matters.

Models classify detected movement. People inspect frames, correct classifications, and contribute reviewed examples for training and model comparisons.

Share the evidence.

Human-confirmed anomalous observations can be published to Internet Archive with video, annotated frames, and sensor context. The public snapshot keeps observation data accessible while station controls stay private.
